usage: agentware bench [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    scorecard   regenerate benchmarks/SCORECARD.md trend table from
                history.jsonl
    redact      scrub operator HOME from ledger gold_path (PII redaction; the
                ONLY sanctioned mutation of the append-only ledger)
    swe         SWE-task behavioral benchmark (hidden-unit-test coding suite)
    lint        gold-set staleness and coverage-ratio check

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
